events.note: Query: COMMAND 10, 599 and '2060;' over 2026-01-15 04:59-05:01. In effect when the window opens, so it began before it. Horizons, 2026-01-15 04:59-05:01 UT: Sun 295.044-295.046, Jupiter 109.456, Chiron 22.673. Sun opposes Jupiter (185.6, orb 8), and Chiron squares the Sun (87.6) and Jupiter (86.8, orb 6) at all three minutes. The symbols list the opposition pair in canonical body order, Jupiter then the Sun, then the focal body, Chiron (PR #1423). The minute it formed at, before the window opened, is the latest forming of its legs by Swiss Ephemeris; Horizons was not queried at it.

Query: COMMAND 10, 199, 299, 499, and every other stellium body to rule it out, over 2026-01-15 04:59-05:01. In effect when the window opens, so it began before it: this is its span, from Mercury joining Mars, the Sun and Venus to Vesta joining on 17 January. At 05:00 UT Horizons has Mercury 290.968, Mars 293.642, Sun 295.045, Venus 297.080, a 6.112 degree spread, and all six pairs stay within the 8 degree conjunction orb at 04:59, 05:00 and 05:01. The clique is maximal: Vesta 301.761 is 8.119 from Mars and 10.792 from Mercury, Pluto 303.160 is 9.518 from Mars and 12.192 from Mercury, and Juno 275.972 is 21.108 from Venus. Lilith, the North Lunar Node and the Lunar Apogee are not Horizons bodies; Swiss Ephemeris puts them over 40 degrees from Mercury. Ends when Vesta joins: Horizons puts Vesta minus Mercury at 8.0001 at 17:31 UT and 7.9993 at 17:32 UT on 17 January, while Mars-Vesta is already 7.487. Only maximal-clique detection (#1363, PR #1427) reports this one. The minute it formed at, before the window opened, is Swiss Ephemeris's; Horizons was not queried at it.

Query: COMMAND 199 and 999 over 2026-01-17 19:45-19:55. Mercury-Pluto enters the 8 degree conjunction orb: Horizons puts Pluto minus Mercury at 8.0005 at 19:49 UT and 7.9994 at 19:50 UT on 2026-01-17.

Query: COMMAND 10, 199, 299, 499, '4;' and 999 over 2026-01-17 19:49-19:51. Closes when its last leg, Mercury-Pluto, enters orb. Horizons at 2026-01-17 19:50 UT: Mercury 295.244, Mars 295.674, Sun 297.712, Venus 300.373, Vesta 303.136, Pluto 303.244, a 7.999 degree spread, so all 15 pairs are within the 8 degree conjunction orb. Its other legs formed before the window. 💫 is the 6-body stellium symbol; the summary read 'undefined' there until the symbol fix for #1362 (PR #1423).
